uutiset.t: Arsenal booed after another home WSL draw as Man Utd beat Blues
uutiset.s: Arsenal were booed by their fans after they held to a sixth successive draw at home, drawing 0-0 with West Ham in the Women's Super League.

uutiset.t: How did Spurs beat Man City?
Yoro sees red eight minutes into Poch's Man Utd reign
uutiset.s: Manchester United's Leny Yoro is shown a straight red card just seven minutes into the match at Anfield after bringing down Alexander Isak just outside of the box.

uutiset.t: Genge eager for England to build on victory in All Blacks rematch
uutiset.s: Ellis Genge called on England to back up their record victory over New Zealand as they go in search of an unprecedented hat-trick against the All Blacks.

uutiset.t: Late McBurnie double sees Hull stun in-form Brighton
uutiset.s: FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from the Premier League match between Hull City and Brighton.

uutiset.t: McBurnie's late double stuns 10-man Brighton after Tzolakis heroics
uutiset.s: A Konstantinos Tzolakis goalkeeping masterclass teed up Oli McBurnie to score two late goals as Hull stunned dominant Brighton in a smash-and-grab 2-0 win at the MKM Stadium.

uutiset.t: 2-0 down, Yamal misses pen, but Barcelona STILL beat Villarreal
uutiset.s: Watch highlights of Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal, as the home side come from 2-0 down, Lamine Yamal misses a penalty, but still come back to win.

uutiset.t: Final Demand battles back to win Punchestown thriller
uutiset.s: Final Demand emerged best of the army of returning Willie Mullins stars on show after a thrilling finish to the John Durkan Memorial Punchestown Chase.

uutiset.t: Burnley’s wait for a home win goes on as Blackburn twice hit back in derby
uutiset.s: Todd Cantwell's penalty earned Blackburn a 2-2 draw at Burnley in their first match since head coach Tony Mowbray stepped back because of health issues.

uutiset.t: Man City lose again as home WSL record crumbles with Spurs defeat
uutiset.s: Manchester City lost for a second WSL game in a row, beaten 3-1 by Tottenham, with their 100 per cent home league record under Andree Jeglertz coming to an abrupt end.

uutiset.t: 'Completely unacceptable! - Vasseur rebukes Leclerc for Hamilton collision
uutiset.s: Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur blamed Charles Leclerc for the "completely unacceptable" collision with team-mate Lewis Hamilton in the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

uutiset.t: 'He's so far below my level' - Verstappen taunts Russell over Las Vegas GP error
uutiset.s: Max Verstappen says George Russell is "so far below my level" in a scathing response to the Mercedes driver after winning the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
